name: What equipment do professionals use for flooded basement cleanup?

mainEntity.name: What equipment do professionals use for flooded basement cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals use specialized equipment for efficient and thorough cleanup. This includes high-powered submersible pumps and industrial wet/dry vacuums for rapid water extraction. Air movers (high-velocity fans) and commercial-grade dehumidifiers are critical for drying out saturated materials and controlling humidity. Moisture meters and thermal imaging cameras are used to detect hidden moisture. Air scrubbers and HEPA vacuums may also be deployed for air quality control, especially if mold is present or suspected.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals use pumps, wet/dry vacuums, air movers, dehumidifiers, moisture meters, and air scrubbers for effective cleanup.
